title: DevX SDK daily scratchpad - doc/todo notes
content:
2026-03-04 Samantha Lee - DevX SDK scratchpad

Top priorities for today:
- [ ] Fix quickstart streaming example in python/quickstart.md -> currently shows full response fetch instead of streaming. Blocks: need example with asyncio + SDK.stream().
    - Owner: Samantha
    - Linked PR: GHPR: redwood/devx#432
- [ ] Add sample app: chat-demo (React + TS) that demonstrates function/tool-calling & structured outputs.
    - Tasks: create minimal backend that proxies requests, include token usage example & cost estimation comments.
    - Owners: Devon (backend), Mikaela (frontend)
- [ ] Update SDK reference for embeddings endpoint: document batch semantics and rate limits. Tickets: JIRA: DOCS-127
- [ ] Quick doc gap: 'model-variants' section missing a short table of compatibility (quantized vs fp16). Add table and one-liner guidance.

Notes / findings:
- Users keep asking how to choose between 'streaming + function-calls' vs 'non-streaming + post-processing' in GH issue thread. Create short guidance doc and link sample.
- Console screenshots in quickstart are outdated (old nav). Need to grab new shots from prod console and replace.
- Tutorial fix: tutorial-2 (embedding search) uses synchronous blocking call in snippet; change to async + add caveat about batch size for latency-sensitive apps.

Scratch ideas / low priority:
- 'playground' sample that toggles batching/quantization and shows latency/cost tradeoffs (could be a small Next.js app) - could be a community repo.
- Add 'common gotchas' section to SDK README: token limits, KV cache tuning, streaming backpressure.

Open questions:
- Do we want to advertise default retry policy in the SDK docs? (pros/cons) - ask SRE.
- Can we include sample KMS integration snippet for private deployments? Ops/security approval needed.

Quick links:
- PR for streaming example: https://github.com/redwood/devx/pull/432
- Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DOCS-127
- Quickstart Confluence draft: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DEVX/pages/RDWD-Docs-Quickstart

Notes to self before EOD:
- Draft PR for python streaming example, run through CI tests locally.
- Ping Devon about chat-demo backend scaffolding and auth flow.
- Add checklist to the Docs PR template to include console screenshots and sample app links.

Random TODO brain dump:
- sample: update node snippet to show SDK.connect(...) with region param
- mention Dedicated vs Hosted model variants in quickstart
- verify embedding dims for new model family 'rw-bison-3' and update docs

---
End of scratchpad (save & move to doc when >60% complete).
